title: Without the Beloved, decoration stays hollow
summary: The line loosens the hand without asking the heart to go cold. Let this stay near the next choice: let this stay with you: without the Beloved and the Shabad, surface beauty stays false.
takeaway: Receive the gift without claiming the outcome.
lifeApplication: Before grasping harder, pause with one hand open and let refuge matter more than possession.

source.shortMeaning: Without the Beloved, decoration cannot cover a heart split by duality.
source.lifeApplication: Before fixing the outside, ask whether the heart is still living in duality.
